notes.title: Check your bio-filters, arm your drones! Update 4 is live
notes.notes:
Hello Runners,

today‘s update adds a ton of visual variety and gameplay improvements. Here‘s what‘s new!

New Arena
Although it may look so much more serene, organic and green, the new arena is no holiday resort! A handpicked selection of new enemies are already waiting for you!

The new arena includes a visually different environment, new enemies and a new highscore list!

To access it, you need a level 8+ drone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922247/05b1c7aba2a1fb61f8b4eeb9a4e87022b7320088.jpg

New Boss
Born from steel and gunpowder, the Mech Jaeger is dealing with severe aggressive tendencies. Be very aware when you face this metal monster – it does not know clemency!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922247/56bd9a2f5b99ce62e67ba8ec31368c11d5456e4d.jpg

Modified Drone System + New Drone Models
First of all, we removed the drone level cap. Your drones passive bonuses increase (HP, armor, DMG) after reaching level ten.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922247/b560f3e53d443f2382783f47feb801b0a4164b95.jpg

Active bonuses are now distributed across different drone types. Once you create a new drone, you can now chose from different bonuses. For example: one drone model lowers your maximum HP but starts out with a life-steal ability.

Additional Improvements

 Changed number of drone slots to six (6)
 Adjusted the visuals of the AoE markers
 Opponent projectiles are now in similar colors
 XP drops no longer look like hostile’s projectiles
 In the pause menu, sound is muted.
 Sound effects have been tweaked and improved.

notes.title: Infinite Dronin Update 3
notes.notes:
Hello Runners,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922247/e8d9d44304666194b03e6d8605da5381c4c6fcf7.jpg

as promised, here is the third batch of updates for Infinite Dronin.

Today we

added the first of many bosses!
made combat more dynamic – it's now possible to cancel attacks
improved armor handling (carefully, as not to botch balancing)
introduce a “Steam Friends“ highscore tab
made minor improvements to the interface and indicators


Find more details on the forums.

Enjoy the game.
Your Infinite Dronin Team

notes.title: Patch Notes Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello Runners!

Here's the second update for Infinite Dronin!

We added online highscores, improved the game here and there and fixed bugs.

Features
Global Online Highscores (optional)
Twitch: Drone Overcharge & added additional power-up and mosters to „send“ options


Improvements

 More options for drone names (12 characters and spaces)
 Highlighting „Add drone“ for new players
 Auto-pickup of power-ups from Twitch viewers
 Consolidated drone buff overview
 Arena and Room number added to stage progression bar


Fixed Bugs

 Issues with the drone menu fixed
 No double „Game over“ screen when terminating a run
 Displaying correct skill info when vote ends


The full list of improvements in a bit more detail we posted on the forums: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1206790/discussions/0/2299597830371689190/


Update / Hotfix 05 June 2020

We just released a hotfix for an issue with the global highscores. It was possible that you could not update your entry with a better run. This is now fixed.

notes.title: Patch Notes Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello Runners!

Today we released the first update to Infinite Dronin.

Features
„Infinite“ now means without end! We lifted the testing restriction of 25 arenas. Now you can run and run and run!
 Highscores! We're starting off with local highscores, keeping track of your most successful runs.
 The number of the arena you are fighting in, now is displayed more visibly on the arena floor.
 Twitch Streamers: You can now change the number and frequency of drones your viewers can send into action.
 Introducing checkpoints: You will not lose your run's rewards should the game crash during a run.


Bug fixes
 The menu key hints are now clickable with your mouse.
 The game can no longer put into pause while the loading screen is displayed.
 Fixed two issues with the „Freeze“ effect: It would play even when sounds were turned off and was way too loud. Not anymore! :)


Coming up
Here's a glimpse what we are currently working on and want to implement in the near future:
 Online Highscores
 Bosses! Fighting those tough enemies will yield bigger and tougher challenges!
 New worlds to fight in
 ...to be continued!
